rec.name: Client Logo Bar (Scrolling "Trusted By" Strip)

what.text: A strip of monochrome (white) customer brand logos, each 32px tall, shown on the homepage and product pages. The theme editor link points to a scrolling-image section, so the strip appears to scroll. The ticket's core is a content and strategy decision about which brand logos to show. Final list: Carrera, Judith Williams, ParfumGroup, That Spiritual Shop, Yoga Boutique, Identim, Gravurschmuck, Hej Natural, Holz4Home, DooNails, Juskys, Ardap Care, plus later additions SIRPLUS and Bodo Schäfer.

why.text: Recognisable brand logos work as borrowed credibility. Visitors see that other shops already use the product and feel less risk. Well-known logos add the most trust. Small unknown logos add little, and a mix helps visitors match their own industry. The strategic trade-off: using the agency's best-known clients would lift conversion but link the product to the agency, which positions itself as a boutique and wants to avoid that association.

how.text: 1) Decide the logo mix (all big brands, all small brands, or a mix such as 3 well-known plus 5 smaller). 2) Collect SVG logo files from clients, because PNGs look pixelated and low-resolution files cause blur on mobile. 3) Make white/monochrome versions at 32px height. 4) Upload them in the Shopify theme editor into the scrolling-image section and add that section to the homepage and PDP template. 5) Check sharpness on desktop and mobile. Where no SVG existed, the logos were redrawn as SVG as a stopgap, and original client SVGs should still be collected.

items: Logo selection and order (brand mix: well-known vs. smaller)
Colour treatment: white monochrome on the section background
File format: SVG preferred over PNG
Scroll/marquee behaviour (speed, direction) of the scrolling-image section
Section placement: homepage and PDP template

dependencies.text: A theme scrolling-image section in the Shopify theme editor. Client-supplied SVG logo files (a recurring bottleneck). Permission from clients to show their logos. Theme admin access to upload the images.

items: Conversion rate on Home and PDP
Bounce rate and scroll depth on Home
Logo render quality on mobile (visual QA)

images.caption: White Gravurschmuck.de logo with tagline, 32px high.
